holdings.thesis: HOLD: no CRDO-specific news dated 11/6-11/9 found despite a dedicated search; analyst coverage found (TD Cowen $160 PT, Barclays $165, consensus clustering $258-279) shows no fresh downgrades. Stop-loss flag eased to -50.9% (from -58.5% on 11/5), tracking the broad AI/chip-sector bounce off the 11/5 correction low rather than a CRDO-specific catalyst. Fundamentals unchanged since last confirmed read (no new quarter since August): revenue growth +114.7% YoY, earnings growth +97.1% YoY. Position ~4.7%.

HOLD: Q3 2026 results (filed 11/3, resolving the disputed 11/9 earnings-date confusion) now confirmed -- DAU 64.9M +29% YoY, paid subscribers 13.1M +14%, revenue $309.0M +14% YoY, bookings $316.1M +12% YoY, FY26 bookings/revenue/adj.-EBITDA guidance raised. GAAP EPS $0.54 missed the $0.56-0.57 consensus and net income fell to $27.2M from $292.2M a year ago -- but last year's figure included a one-time $222.7M deferred-tax valuation-allowance release, which explains essentially all of the quant screen's -90.9% earnings-growth flag as a YoY comp artifact rather than new deterioration (confirms the standing 'known, deliberate' read from prior reviews, now with the actual filing in hand). Operating income still fell 31% as expenses outpaced revenue, a real margin item to keep watching. Return eased to +21.0% (from +23.1% on 11/5) on the EPS-miss reaction even as the broader market bounced. Dearborn Heights securities-fraud lead-plaintiff deadline (12/7/26) remains unresolved. Position ~13.0%, still under the 15% cap.

HOLD, earnings now confirmed: Q3 2026 results (reported 11/5, resolving the prior date dispute) were strong -- revenue +53% YoY to $95.6M (beat), net income +24% to $10.3M, diluted EPS $0.29 (beat consensus by ~70%), FY26 revenue-growth guidance raised to 42%+ (from 40%+), cash $164M (+99% YTD). A single unverified source (Metaintro) reported ~550 India staff losing system access in an Oct 26 layoff event with no corroboration found. Despite the beat, the stop-loss flag deepened slightly to -53.4% (from -51.3% on 11/5) -- a continued disconnect between fundamentals and price that reads as unresolved sentiment/de-rating risk on the name rather than a fresh fundamental break; worth watching closely given the magnitude. Position ~1.0% (token size).

HOLD: no new VRT-specific catalyst found beyond management's scheduled fireside chat at the Baird Global Industrial Conference on 11/10 -- no negative news, earnings miss, or guidance cut located. Stop-loss flag eased to -38.0% (from -45.3% on 11/5), tracking the broad AI/data-center-adjacent bounce off the 11/5 correction low. Fundamentals last confirmed: revenue growth +61.2% YoY, earnings growth +91.2% YoY (no new quarter since Q3 report). Position ~7.4%.

HOLD: Q3 2026 results (reported 10/28, now fully confirmed) showed revenue +25% YoY to $127.6B and Cloud revenue +103% YoY to $30.7B (cloud operating income more than tripled), but GAAP EPS of $2.12 missed the ~$2.94 consensus and net income fell 25% YoY on an $8.7B equity-investment loss plus capex of $51.4B (2x YoY, driving FCF to -$9.1B) -- this is the known, already-priced capex/equity-markdown story behind the quant screen's EARNINGS_DECLINING flag, not a new deterioration, and it sits alongside genuinely accelerating top-line/cloud growth. No news dated after 10/28 found. Return improved to -14.7% (from -16.3% on 11/5). Kaplan Fox securities class-action lead-plaintiff deadline (12/1/26) remains unresolved. Position ~14.0%, approaching but not past the 15% cap.

HOLD: no new AMZN-specific news found since the 10/29 Q3 report (AWS +39% YoY, trailing FCF -$42.4B on the $220B 2026 capex guide). Return improved to +2.6% (from +0.02% on 11/5), tracking the broad market bounce. Position ~14.1%, approaching but not past the 15% cap.

HOLD: no new XOM-specific news found; thesis unchanged from the 10/30 Q3 beat (adj EPS $4.23, refining-margin tailwind, $20B buyback confirmed into 2027). Return roughly flat at +3.0% (from +3.4% on 11/5). Position ~12.4%.

HOLD: fiscal Q1 2027 results (reported after close 11/5) now confirmed -- revenue $1.26B beat the $1.21B estimate and the company's own $1.19-1.22B guide, GMV +34% YoY to $14.4B; EPS sources conflict ($0.47 reported, described as both a beat vs. a ~$0.35 consensus and -- less plausibly -- a miss vs. an $0.86 figure that doesn't reconcile with trailing-year EPS of $0.23) but the revenue/GMV beat and raised fiscal Q2 revenue guide ($1.44-1.47B) read as a solid quarter overall. Operating cash flow fell to $207.1M (from $374.6M YoY) and funding costs rose 27bps sequentially -- a real, if modest, cost-of-capital watch item as management expects rates to stay elevated into FY27. Return eased to -2.7% (from -0.4% on 11/5) despite the beat, a muted reaction. Position ~6.1%.

HOLD: no new DDOG-specific news found beyond the already-known 11/4 Q3 beat-and-raise-but-weak-Q4-guidance story (customer-concentration risk from one large customer cutting usage to its minimum commitment). HOLD, strong beat confirmed: Q3 2026 results (reported 11/3) beat decisively -- revenue $584.9M (+154% YoY, +49% QoQ, a single-quarter record), non-GAAP EPS $1.32 (vs. ~$1.19 est.), Q4 guide $730-750M (vs. ~$656M consensus), with Scorpio switches now the largest product line. Shares still traded down modestly after hours on the print and the stock had already fallen 11% on 10/30 amid broader AI-capex jitters unrelated to the company. Known customer-concentration risk (top 4 ~82% of Q2 revenue) remains disclosed and stable, not worsening. Stop-loss flag eased sharply to -25.2% (right at the threshold, from -38.1% on 11/5) -- the beat-and-raise is a clear positive despite the price not yet reflecting it; continuing to hold through the disconnect rather than selling into clearly strong, accelerating fundamentals. Position ~1.1%.
